headlines.title: Wall Street Nears Record Highs With Help From Mag 7
headlines.summary: Stocks rallied during Thursday's session, nearing record levels, with some help from the Magnificent Seven.  The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF was up 2.7% to $70.58, just a stone's throw from its record closing price of $70.94.  The Nasdaq was up 1.4% while the S&P 500 rose 1%.

headlines.title: Vietnamese Rival To Uber, Lyft Plans To Enter U.S. Market This Year
headlines.summary: The VinFast-linked rideshare company GSM plans to enter the U.S. market by the end of this year, the company said.

headlines.title: Armadin Names Frank Verdecanna Chief Financial Officer
headlines.summary: Armadin, an AI-native cybersecurity company building effective autonomous security, today announced that Frank Verdecanna has joined the company as Chief Financial Officer.

headlines.title: Google won’t have to sell off ad exchange in ad-tech monopoly case
headlines.summary: Instead, according to a federal judge, the tech giant will be required to implement less severe behavioral remedies.

headlines.title: Workato and Lenovo Announce Strategic Collaboration to Expand Lenovo Qira's Cross-App Capabilities
headlines.summary: PALO ALTO, Calif., September 03, 2026--Workato®, the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI, and Lenovo™ today announced their strategic collaboration to support the continued evolution of Lenovo Qira, Lenovo’s Personal Ambient Intelligence, which is actively expanding across Lenovo's device lineup. Through this collaboration, Workato is helping expand Lenovo Qira's ability to execute workflows across multiple applications.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
